primary_population: candidate observations; fixed preselected cell pairs
co_primary_A: intersection-union of positive all-pair cell-contrast direction above 0.5 and positive Spearman; p_A=max(one-sided direction permutation p, one-sided rho permutation p)
co_primary_B: all-pair variant direction above 0.5; one-sided locus sign-flip permutation p
correction: Holm across A and B; separate Holm family for paired alternate improvements
zero_or_missing: absolute delta<=epsilon wrong in all-pair direction; numerical zeros retained in rho; missing remain denominator and excluded rho with explicit coverage
selection: gene-free development arms only; >=3pp all-pair cell contrast direction gain, <=3pp scored-pair coverage loss; tie rho then variant direction; else baseline
calibration: development-only affine least squares; test evaluation without refitting
independence: transitive overlapping 200kb TSS windows, LD blocks unavailable
